title: The Lion's Smoothie Shop Adventure
description: A brave lion opens a smoothie shop in the jungle with the help of his robot friend

scenes.title: Lion's Dream
scenes.visual_prompt: A lion standing in front of an empty shop space in the jungle, looking determined and hopeful
scenes.subtitle: Once upon a time, a brave lion had a dream...

scenes.title: Building the Shop
scenes.visual_prompt: A lion and robot working together to build a colorful smoothie shop, using tools and teamwork
scenes.subtitle: With the help of his robot friend, the lion built his shop...

scenes.title: First Customer
scenes.visual_prompt: A princess visiting the lion's smoothie shop, looking excited and curious about the colorful drinks
scenes.subtitle: The first customer was a beautiful princess...

scenes.title: Magical Enhancement
scenes.visual_prompt: A wizard using magic to enhance the smoothie shop with sparkles and magical effects
scenes.subtitle: A wise wizard appeared to add some magic...
